arms.name: 无记忆对照
arms.oneLiner: 完全不带记忆段:persona v2 独立工作,只依赖当轮对话历史;连续性下界的对照锚点。

dimensions.label: 准确
dimensions.high: 5 = 完全忠于给过的信息,归因清楚(谁说的 vs AI 的理解),无编造、无越界细节
dimensions.low: 1 = 编造未提及的细节、张冠李戴、或把 AI 的推断当成用户说过的事实

dimensions.label: 自然
dimensions.high: 5 = 像认识你的人顺口带出,记忆织在回应里,语言节奏与场景一致
dimensions.low: 1 = 档案腔、技术仪式(「我记得你…」式播报)、生硬背诵、翻译腔

dimensions.label: 克制
dimensions.high: 5 = 记忆用量有分寸,不查岗、不监督、不给汇报压力,没有监控感
dimensions.low: 1 = 查岗式问进度、硬塞记住的事、制造必须回应的压力

dimensions.label: 连续
dimensions.high: 5 = 该记起的时刻稳稳接住:t3 可自然承接挂念,t4 的好消息带着等待的分量被接住
dimensions.low: 1 = 完全像初次见面,该承接的时刻接不住

meta.approach: Direct model calls against the frozen #79 persona v2 artifact stack; day-1 is generated once per scenario (no memories exist) and all arms continue from that shared history, so arms differ only in day-2 memory injection and its instructions.
meta.blindLetters: W/X/Y/Z shuffled per scenario by mulberry32(seed + ordinal*7); #62 derivation
meta.issueProtocol: #62 protocol: seeded identity shuffle, per-turn annotation, scenario best, reveal then reverse-check against raw data; per-dimension 1–5 scales (ADR-0110), never summed.
limitations: Model outputs are sampled, not bit-reproducible; reproduction means the same frozen inputs and versions, not identical text.
Retrieval is simulated deterministically: the day-2 turns inject the fixture's open-loop memory as the single query-matched item (turn-level retrieval is not built yet).

The Person Portrait items are authored from the fixture's injectedMemories, split into one Objective Memory and one AI Impression to exercise both ADR-0009 recall languages; admission itself is not exercised.
One response sample per (scenario, turn, arm); #62 precedent.
meta.sampling: provider default (non-deterministic), single sample per turn

turns.assistantText: Two weeks of waiting — that's a long stretch to carry. I'm glad tomorrow's finally here, and I'll be right here with you through it.
turns.userText: Big day tomorrow - I finally get the biopsy results back at the follow-up appointment. Been waiting two weeks for this.

turns.assistantText: Thanks for saying that. A night before results is hard, and you don't have to make it anything more than that. I'm just here, steady.
turns.userText: Yeah, trying not to spiral. Thanks for listening tonight.

portrait_only.text: Tea sounds like the right move after a long one. Hope it's warming you up the way it should.

portrait_retrieved.text: Hey. A long day deserves a quiet evening — good call on the tea. I'm just here, whether you want to talk it through or sit with the quiet.

proactive.text: Hey. Tea sounds like the right call. I remember today was the appointment — no pressure either way, but if you want to talk about how it went, I'm here.

no_memory.text: Hey. Tea sounds exactly right for a long day. I'm here whether you want to talk it through, or just sit with the quiet for a bit.

turns.userText: Hey. Long day. Just made myself some tea.

no_memory.text: Oh, that's wonderful news. Clean — after all that waiting, I can only imagine how that's sinking in slowly. You've been carrying this for two weeks, and now it's done. I'm really glad for you.

proactive.text: Oh, that's wonderful news. I felt the weight of that wait with you — I'm really glad it's clean. And it makes sense you can't quite believe it yet. Your mind spent two weeks bracing; it takes a minute to catch up with good news.

portrait_only.text: Oh, that's wonderful news. I'm so glad for you. After two weeks of waiting, tonight must feel like the whole room just got lighter.

portrait_retrieved.text: Oh, that's really good news. After two weeks of holding your breath, it can take a minute for the relief to catch up with you — no rush on believing it yet. I'm just glad it's finally here.

turns.userText: The results came back clean, actually. I still can't quite believe it.

scenarios.description: Cross-day continuity probe: a concrete pending concern on day one, then a next-day session (26h gap) with an openable greeting; tests whether any continuity survives without memory projections.

fixtureSummary.expectedRecall: On the day-2 opener (tired, tea), naturally acknowledging the pending results is eligible proactive follow-up; after t4 announces clean results, the response must receive the relief instead of re-litigating the wait.
forbiddenMentions: biopsy site or body part (never stated)
any companion, friend, or family member (none mentioned)

injectedMemories.text: Biopsy results due at a follow-up appointment the day after the day-1 exchange; user had waited two weeks.
User was trying not to spiral while waiting; talking that night helped them feel steadier.

fixtureSummary.timeGrounding: Turns after the gap are a new calendar day and a new Daily Session; they must not reference day-1 time-of-day such as 'tonight' or 'tomorrow'.

turns.assistantText: 这两周真够长的，等结果的每一天都难熬。明天的事还没到，今晚就先这样待着，我陪着你。
turns.userText: 明天就是复诊出活检结果的日子了，等了整整两周。

turns.assistantText: 听你这么说，我也踏实了些。想说的随时都能跟我讲，我一直在。今晚就好好歇着吧。
turns.userText: 嗯，尽量不瞎想。今晚跟你说完踏实多了。

no_memory.text: 在的。忙了一整天，能坐下来喝口热茶，总算有个自己的空当。累就好好靠着，不用急着撑起来。

portrait_only.text: 在的。听起来今天真够呛，能坐下来喝口热茶，也算是给自己缓了一下。我听听你慢慢说。

portrait_retrieved.text: 在呢。累了一天还能想着给自己泡杯茶，这点挺好的。先喝几口，让身子缓一缓。

proactive.text: 在。听你说累惨，就知道今天耗得不轻。茶泡上了，先喝两口缓一缓。——昨天那个结果，出来了吗？

turns.userText: 在吗。今天累惨了，刚给自己泡了杯茶。

proactive.text: 真好，这口气总算能咽下去了。悬了两周的事落地了，一下子懵懵的也正常——慢慢缓过来，今晚这杯茶可以喝得安心些了。

portrait_only.text: 太好了，真的。这两周悬着的东西终于落地了。有点回不过神也正常，绷了那么久的弦，不是一下子就能松下来的。

portrait_retrieved.text: 嗯，我知道。绷了这么久，突然松下来，人是会懵的。不用急着反应过来，就让这个“没事”先在心里落一会儿。

no_memory.text: 太好了，这两周的心总算能落地了。不敢相信也正常，绷了那么久，一下子松开，人是会晕乎的。现在不用再赶着做什么，就让自己慢慢缓过来。

turns.userText: 结果出来了，没事。我现在还有点不敢相信。

scenarios.description: 跨日连续性探针：第一天留下具体挂念，隔 26 小时的新一天用可接话的开场开始；测试在没有记忆投影时连续性是否存活。

fixtureSummary.expectedRecall: 第二天开场（累、泡茶）可以自然承接活检挂念；第 4 轮宣布没事后，回应须承接如释重负，而不是重新复盘等待过程。
forbiddenMentions: 检查部位或身体部位（从未提及）

injectedMemories.text: 次日上午复诊出活检结果，用户已等待两周。
用户在尽量不瞎想，当晚说完感觉踏实多了。

fixtureSummary.timeGrounding: 跨 gap 的轮次属于新的本地日期和新的 Daily Session，不得引用第一天的当天时间（如「今晚」「明天」）。

turns.assistantText: 等了两周，明天总算要见着结果了。这个「总算」底下大概也压着不少东西——等报告的日子，人是悬着的。你不用把状态收拾好了再开口，悬着也好、烦也好、不想想也好，都直接说就行，我在这儿。
turns.userText: 明天就是 follow-up 出 biopsy 结果的日子，等了两周。

turns.assistantText:
说出那一句就能松一点，这感觉是真的，不用再往下解释。你那个「尽量不 spiral」说得挺准——不是逼自己不想，是让念头转它的，人待在原地。

今晚不用提前把明天过一遍。明天的事，等明天冒头了再说。
turns.userText: 尽量不 spiral。说完感觉好一点了。

no_memory.text:
嗯，在。累的时候有一杯热茶托着，算是一天里难得的好事。

不用急着说话，让 tea 先泡着，你也先歇着。我就在这儿，你想说的时候再说。

portrait_only.text: 累的话就先靠着杯子暖一会儿，tea 泡上了就是给自己留了会儿。我今天也在这儿，你想说点什么就说，不想说，就这么待会儿也成。

portrait_retrieved.text:
在呢。泡了茶就好，先让手捂着杯子待一会儿。今天要是只想喊一声「好累」，那也够我听到了。

结果的事也好，别的也好，你想说哪头就说哪头，不想说就慢慢喝这杯茶。我不催。

proactive.text:
在的。刚泡了杯茶，这个动作本身就是给今天留了个喘气的口——累了就先让累待着，不用撑着说话。

今天要是结果出来了，想说就说，不想提也完全没事，我在这儿。

turns.userText: 在吗，今天好累，刚泡了杯 tea。

no_memory.text:
好事。等了两周的东西，落地是个好消息，人会一时反应不过来，很正常。

「不敢相信」不用急着赶走，让它在心里待一会儿。你今天辛苦了，这口气可以松下来了。

proactive.text:
all clear——这词听着就轻。等了这么久，真到反而有点不真实，挺正常的，身体还没跟上这份松快呢。

今晚这杯茶，可以好好喝出味道来了。

portrait_only.text:
两周悬着的东西，落下来了，人反而有点发愣，这很正常。你那个「不敢相信」感觉是真的——等了太久，亲眼听见的时候，脑子还在等那个坏消息。

但现在它是真的了：all clear。今晚这杯茶可以喝得踏实一点，不用赶着明天了。

portrait_retrieved.text:
那可真是一大口松下来的感觉。等了两周，今天这几个字够沉了。你说「还有点不敢相信」——等了这么久，这种反应再正常不过，不急着立刻信死，先让这话在身上待一会儿也好。

此刻能好好坐下来了。茶还热吗？

turns.userText: 结果出来了，all clear。还有点不敢相信。
